Section 3(a) authorized and designated the Office of Personnel Management under 5 U.S.C. 5305(a), as amended by section 101 of the Federal Employees Pay Comparability Act of 1990, to exercise the President's authority over higher rates of pay. Section 2(a) of Executive Order 13415 (signed December 1, 2006; 71 FR 70641, published December 5, 2006) provides that sections 3 and 6 of Executive Order 12748 of February 1, 1991, as amended, are revoked, and that order sets no later effective date, so the revocation is dated its signing. The functions of the President under sections 4505a, 5305 and 5377 of title 5 were assigned by section 1 of the same order to the Director of the Office of Personnel Management. No earlier ending of this provision is shown: the order has no own-terms end, no earlier order revokes it, and the delegation was exercised under statutes that remain in the Code.

Section 9(a) of this order provides that sections 1 through 4, except as otherwise provided by Public Law 101-509, take effect on February 3, 1991, so the revocation was carried out on that date; the command is exhausted by performance and Executive Order 11721 remains revoked. research_rationale:
Executive Order 12748 of February 1, 1991 (56 FR 4521, Federal Register Vol. 56 No. 23, Monday February 4, 1991; FR Doc. 91-2873) provides for Federal pay administration under the Federal Employees Pay Comparability Act of 1990. The held original is the machine-extracted text of the govinfo Federal Register PDF with Sections 1 to 9, the document number and dateline present, so identity and completeness were confirmed against the text. The held U.S. Code release point 119-121 prints the order as a note to 5 U.S.C. 5301 (CURRENT:EO:12748#0) and states that it is amended by Executive Order 12883, section 8 of Executive Order 13106 and section 2(a) of Executive Order 13415; that is the current predicate for the continuing clauses. Later events read from the held official texts: Executive Order 12883 (1993-11-29) added section 2(c); Executive Order 13106 section 8 (1998-12-07) amended section 2(c); Executive Order 13415 section 2(a) (2006-12-01) revoked sections 3 and 6 and renumbered sections 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 as sections 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7. Sections 3 and 6 are terminated by that express revocation. Sections 4, 5 and 8(a) are self-executing revocations or amendments performed on their stated effective dates, 1991-02-03 and 1991-05-04. Sections 1, 2, 7, 8(b) and 9 are carried as continuing; 8(b) is carried on a disclosed limited basis because no held source shows when the Executive Assignment System termination was completed. The Code note on 5 U.S.C. 5301 and the Federal Register catalogue search show no later revocation of the remaining sections. The authority statutes (5 U.S.C. 5303, 5304, 5305) remain in the Code.
